overview.titleZh: 多肽药物研发：GLP-1领域进展、安全性研究与计算设计方法
overview.summaryZh: 本期内容主要围绕GLP-1受体激动剂等多肽药物展开，涵盖临床试验、安全性研究、市场动态以及计算设计方法。临床试验方面，涉及磷酸二酯酶抑制剂对肠促胰素分泌的影响，以及抗阻训练预防替西帕肽治疗期间的肌肉流失。文献方面，多篇研究探讨GLP-1药物的疗效与安全性，包括马兹度肽治疗肥胖、SGLT2抑制剂与GLP-1受体激动剂在特定患者中的肾脏结局、GLP-1受体激动剂与精神及眼部疾病、痴呆及帕金森病风险、骨折风险等。此外，有预印本研究关注环肽-蛋白质复合物预测和大环分子胶的从头设计。行业动态方面，诺和诺德启动口服Wegovy更低剂量III期试验，Amylyx宣布GLP-1抑制剂III期成功，并分析了成本与认知对GLP-1市场的影响以及大型药企财报启示。
themes: GLP-1受体激动剂在多适应症中的疗效与安全性
GLP-1治疗相关的肌肉流失与营养管理
多肽药物的计算设计与预测方法

items.titleZh: 从头设计大环分子胶：EvoBind-multimer框架
items.summaryZh: 研究团队开发了深度学习框架EvoBind-multimer，可直接从蛋白质序列从头设计大环分子胶，无需已知界面或配体。该框架成功将E3连接酶VHL招募至KRAS和BRD4，并通过活细胞NanoBRET证实了设计诱导的邻近效应。机制验证显示，生成的大环肽能形成功能性VHL-靶标三元复合物，驱动蛋白酶体降解和下游信号关闭。然而，在患者来源的异种移植神经母细胞瘤类器官中，相同的大环肽在不同患者模型中表现为强效降解剂或稳定型LOCKTAC，表明三元复合物的处理具有高度上下文依赖性。
items.whatItIsZh: 这是一项关于利用深度学习从头设计大环分子胶的预印本研究。
items.whyItMattersZh: 该研究为分子胶的设计提供了一种新方法，可能推动诱导邻近药物的开发。但结果来自预印本，未经同行评审，且机制在不同背景下存在差异，需进一步验证。

items.originalTitle: De novo Design of Macrocyclic Molecular Glues
items.originalSummary: The engineering of induced proximity has transformed drug discovery, yet the development of molecular glues remains largely serendipitous and restricted to the retrospective optimisation of accidental discoveries. Here, we present EvoBind-multimer, a deep learning framework for the de novo design of molecular glues directly from protein sequences. Unlike structure-based docking, our method generates small macrocyclic peptides that bridge user-defined protein pairs without requiring prior interface knowledge or existing ligands. We applied this framework to recruit the E3 ligase VHL to two challenging oncoproteins: KRAS and BRD4. Live-cell NanoBRET demonstrated robust design-induced proximity for both pairs. Mechanistic validation demonstrated that the generated macrocycles form functional VHL-target ternary complexes capable of driving Cullin-RING ligase-dependent proteasomal degradation and downstream signalling shutdown. Finally, evaluation in patient-derived xenograft neuroblastoma tumoroids revealed that ternary complex processing is deeply context-dependent: identical macrocycles acted as potent degraders in one patient model, yet functioned as stabilising "LOCKTACs" in another, driving VHL-dependent target sequestration without turnover. By enabling the de novo design of induced proximity from sequence alone, EvoBind-multimer provides a route towards designing new protein functions.

items.titleZh: 时间营养与产前心理健康：食物摄入指标与产前抑郁症状的关系
items.summaryZh: 该研究为一项二次分析，基于妊娠糖尿病筛查策略比较试验的718名参与者数据，探讨孕中期食物摄入指标与产前抑郁症状的关联。结果显示，进食频率、零食频率、夜间零食频率和每日总能量摄入与抑郁症状总分正相关。早餐能量摄入与高抑郁症状患病率正相关，而晚餐能量摄入、首次进食时间较晚和第一能量四分位数与高抑郁症状患病率负相关。
items.whatItIsZh: 这是一项关于时间营养与产前抑郁症状关联的观察性研究。
items.whyItMattersZh: 该研究将时间营养与抑郁的关联扩展到产前阶段，提示饮食模式可能影响孕期心理健康。但证据来自横断面分析，无法推断因果，需要进一步纵向研究。

items.originalTitle: Chrononutrition and prenatal mental health: The relationship between food intake indicators and prenatal depressive symptomatology
items.originalSummary: Abstract Aim: Examine cross-sectional associations between mid-pregnancy food intake indicators and prenatal depressive symptomatology. Methods: This secondary analysis of the Comparison of Two Screening Strategies for Gestational Diabetes trial (N = 718) examined domains of mid-pregnancy food intake (direct timing, energy timing, meal/snack structure, meal energy distribution, diet quality) derived from 24-hour dietary recalls. Depressive symptoms were measured with the Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale (EPDS). Generalized linear models examined associations between food intake indicators, total, and high (EPDS [ ]13) depressive symptoms. Results: Mean (SD) EPDS score was [6.3 (4.9)]; 12.4% (n = 89) had high depressive symptoms. Eating frequency (B = 0.08 [0.02, 0.14], p = 0.009), snack frequency (B = 0.06 [0.00, 0.12], p = 0.040), nighttime snacking frequency (B = 0.06 [0.00, 0.11], p = 0.041), and total daily energy intake (B = 0.06 [0.01, 0.12], p = 0.031) were positively associated with total depressive symptoms. Energy intake from breakfast (PR = 1.2 [1.0, 1.3], p = 0.017) was associated with a higher prevalence of high depressive symptoms. Energy intake from dinner (PR = 0.81 [0.69, 0.94], p = 0.007), later timing of the first eating episode (PR = 0.83 [0.70, 0.99], p = 0.034) and first energy quartile (PR = 0.84 [0.70, 1.0], p = 0.048), were associated with a lower prevalence of high depressive symptoms. Conclusion: These findings extend prior chrononutrition-depression literature to the prenatal period, implicating eating frequency, energy intake, and meal energy timing and distribution in depressive symptomatology during pregnancy, warranting further longitudinal investigation.
